title: Kallaway-style dark overlay cards (full-screen and lower-third)
what_it_does: About 300 HTML cards in a dark creator style: tier 1 full-screen takeovers (stats, agenda, comparisons, flows) and tier 2 floating callouts, badges and labels over the speaker, with slots and a registry.json index.
when_to_use: Adding designed cards over a talking-head video.
why: MIT-style grant covers the cards; colours come from the AIS brand (tokens.css) and AIS logo/guideline are explicitly not licensed, so take the cards and replace the tokens with ours. Card HTML is 1920x1080 fixed, so vertical needs rework.
